mapper.select: SELECT po.order_id AS orderId, p.product_name AS productTitle, po.total_amount AS totalAmount, po.deal_type AS dealType, po.created_at AS createdAt, CASE WHEN po.buyer_id = #{userId} THEN 'BUYER' ELSE 'SELLER' END AS myRole FROM product_orders po JOIN products p ON po.product_id = p.product_id WHERE po.buyer_id = #{userId} OR po.seller_id = #{userId} ORDER BY po.created_at DESC
